entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [API Proposal]: Add 'e' format specifier for "extended date" in DateTime formatting #121467
    Future
  • Ensure reasonable behavior on exceptions during suspension #121465
  • `TensorSpan<T>.FlattenTo` is 80x slower with the .NET 10 package #121463
  • EventPipe doesn't correctly recompute global keyword and level filters after session close #121462
  • Production server freeze/deadlock on .NET 9.0.7, CPU 0, gdb points to __GI_cfsetispeed in multiple threads #121461
  • [RuntimeAsync] Test failure in NonDisposedSocket_SafeHandlesCollected with runtime async enabled. #121459
    11.0.0

Closed

  • bug(ConfigurationBuilder): Empty value in json read wrong use ConfigurationBuilder on NET10 #121436
    Future

PullRequests

Created

  • Convert build-runtime.cmd to PowerShell #121469
  • Catch exception in SerialStream constructor if DTR or RTS is not available (Windows) #121468
    community-contribution, area-System.IO.Ports
  • [RuntimeAsync] Do not hold to the last used Continuation in the runtime async tasks. #121460
    area-VM-coreclr, runtime-async

Merged

  • Virtual methods with runtime async #121443
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Add docs to breaking change workflow. #120988
    enhancement, area-Meta, breaking-change, needs-breaking-change-doc-created
  • Cleanup Windows error mode setting with media insertion propmt #121464
    area-System.IO, community-contribution
  • Remove unsafe code from SmtpReplyReaderFactory.ProcessRead #121297
    area-System.Net, reduce-unsafe, 11.0.0

Updated

  • Introduce a new internal EventSourceGenerator and use it for all ES implementations #121180
    needs-area-label

    area-Infrastructure-libraries
  • Mark HttpClient.Send tests uniformly with UnsupportedOSPlatform for Android, iOS #120716
    area-System.Net.Http, test-enhancement, community-contribution, 11.0.0
  • Breaking change doc tool #120987
    area-Meta
  • Emit IL for AsyncResumptionStub #121456
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Adjust `OFFSETOF__Thread__m_pInterpThreadContext` for Apple mobile simulators #121442
    os-ios, area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Add support for emitting Mach-O R2R images #121186
    area-crossgen2-coreclr, os-ios, 11.0.0

    area-System.Security, 11.0.0
  • [cDAC] Update DebugInfo contract for new format #121418
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr

    area-CodeGen-coreclr, runtime-async
